Agenda item is a partnership MOU between OUSD and the charter school, consistent with a charter school located within the district
The school's former website domain (rosesinconcrete.org) now shows unrelated content, so it was not used; the school is closed, so current status is unclear
research.notes: The school appears to have closed June 30, 2020 per state data, so the MOU may predate that or the entity may still exist as a nonprofit. profile.summary: A nonprofit that operated Roses in Concrete, a K-8 charter school in East Oakland, California. The school opened in 2015 and, according to state records, closed in June 2020.
